svg.text: Inventory Management System - Complete UML Class Diagram (Week 10)
+ «create» Product(product_id: String, name: String, price: Real,
price: Real, stock_quantity: Integer, supplier: Supplier,
price: Real, stock_quantity: Integer, supplier: Supplier,
Notation: solid line + hollow triangle = inheritance (generalisation) | dashed line + hollow triangle = interface realisation | solid line = association (open arrow = the class that is referred to)
hollow diamond = aggregation | filled diamond = composition | «abstract» / italics = abstract class or method | underlined = class-level (static) member | - private + public
Types: String, Integer, Real, Boolean, void = no return value, Dictionary = key/value map | [0..*] = zero or more | [0..1] = optional (zero or one) | «create» = constructor
